reuse.why: Fintegra reuses findOrCreateBank and linkBankSyncAccount, and takeover reuses unlinkAccount, although its downloader copies existing provider logic.

duplication.why: The change repeats the preflight sequence across six handlers, duplicates the transaction downloader structure, and repeats refusal-test setup and assertions.

placement.why: Provider transport, configuration, and models follow existing layers, but common preflight orchestration remains distributed across provider handlers.

scope.why: All changes support the requested linking rules, takeover option, Fintegra integration, or their tests.

maintainability.why: Existing linking abstractions remain useful, but repeated preflight wiring and a validation-named helper that unlinks accounts obscure ownership of the linking workflow.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All six provider handlers use linkBankSyncAccount and the shared validation helpers; takeover delegates account clearing to unlinkAccount.

disguised_duplication.where: sync.ts: downloadFintegraTransactions reshapes the existing Akahu downloader through compact request objects and simplified response-variable construction while retaining its authentication, POST, error handling, and response mapping.

abstraction_drift.where: Takeover adds replaceExistingLink to the shared linking interface and guard, with a conditional unlink path, and adds suppressProviderCleanup to unlinkAccount, extending its early-return condition; no linking caller bypasses the shared definitions.
